label: B25-NOFP-FRESH-PHYSICAL
title: Fresh synthesis, fitter and STA for the corrected scalar bring-up profile
scope: Build a byte/hash-bound physical staging tree from the exact d00d566d no-FP profile plus freshly generated boot.mif, create a never-before-used GamePC probe, and run synthesis -> fitter -> signoff STA with source/database audits between stages. This task does not run assembler or produce/program a SOF.
profile_boundary: A64_FP_SIMD=0 scalar bring-up only. Physical success proves timing/resource closure for PC=0/UART/DDR feedback, not final P7/full-FP release equivalence.

pipeline_gate.profile_state: done at d00d566d: exact one-line functional diff, parameter propagation, no-FP core/SoC/platform lint, scalar-only monitor disassembly, M20K focused timing, and CAL-OK/CAL-WAIT/CAL-FAIL SoC smoke all PASS
allowed_now: local physical staging and manifest generation
pipeline_gate.reason: T-20260919-003 is accepted with local L0-L2 evidence, so the previously gated downstream physical stages are released.

validation.source: canonical physical manifest, QSF-relative aliases, platform payload, MIF WIDTH=64 DEPTH=8192 records=8192, no preexisting database/artifact
validation.synthesis: Quartus 21.4 success, no elaboration errors, boot M20K consumes the expected init_file, no stale final database
validation.fitter: fit success and resource/M20K inventory recorded
validation.sta: sys_clk_25 and global setup/hold/recovery/removal/min-pulse nonnegative; DDR, metastability, FIFO payload, data-delay and normalized UCP invariants pass
validation.process: 20-minute event-aware WaitForExit interval returns immediately on completion; monitor records actual descendant parallelism and does not assume that the 16-processor maximum yields 16-way root synthesis

acceptance: Fresh source closure, synthesis, fitter, STA and all custom physical gates pass on the exact profile SHA. Any negative timing or unsupported no-FP parameterization is reported honestly and blocks assembler.
resource: Every remote access and stage acquires gamepc. Never overlap another GamePC CPU/host-memory job. No local heavy job is required. The run uses Quartus's existing maximum allowed 16/24 processors without a 16 GiB cap; it records actual process fan-out and memory.
forbidden_regions: tracked source/QSF/SDC/RTL changes or task-local source patches
quartus_pgm, JTAG, board reset/power or Flash action
authorization: Existing user authorization covers Quartus/JTAG bring-up execution, but this task intentionally stops before assembler and board state changes.

progress.source: 174/174 file hashes, 50/50 QSF references, profile top, corrected M20K RTL and 8192x64 MIF verified; no preexisting database or forbidden artifact

synthesis.actual_parallelism_note: Run completed before the first 20-minute snapshot, so descendant fan-out was not sampled and no 16-way utilization claim is made.
synthesis.monitor_note: PowerShell Process.ExitCode was null, but Quartus stdout, syn.summary and flow.rpt independently report Successful, 0 errors; authoritative synthesis audit PASS.

sta_signoff.monitor_note: The first wrapper read redirected stdout before its async reader drained and reported quartus_tool_success=False. Authoritative stdout/report contain Timing Analyzer successful, 0 errors; corrected postflight audit PASS without rerunning STA.

progress.bram: soc|bram|u_impl is 8192x64 True Dual Port M20K, 524288 bits, init_file ../boot/build/boot.mif
progress.post_synthesis_inputs: 174 inputs verified: 172 byte-identical; QSF CRLF normalization and Qsys_bb CRLF plus one trailing blank line normalize to exact source; 0 content mismatches
progress.custom_acceptance: PASS: source pre/post identical; FIFO payload 24/24 cut; data-delay 20/20 nonnegative; normalized UCP/reset accepted by T-20260919-005
progress.next_gate: Register and run a one-shot assembler clone; T-20260919-002 Gate D and every physical gate are accepted

next_after_acceptance: After T-20260919-002 Gate D also passes, register/run a one-shot assembler task for a new volatile SOF, then repeat the T-044 interaction procedure.
